title: How to earn with crypto
h1: How to earn with crypto: realistic paths, returns and risks
seo_title: How to earn with crypto: staking, stablecoin yield, airdrops, bug bounties and more
description: Realistic ways to earn with crypto, with effort, capital, sourced return ranges and risks, live yields, and what's hot in October 2026.
summary: Seven earning paths with effort, capital, sourced return ranges and risks, live DefiLlama yields, and a dated 'what's hot' section.
plain: You can earn with crypto by lending, staking, helping new projects early, finding bugs, or making content. Every path has a catch. Higher returns always mean higher risk, even when you can't see the risk.
Safe-looking yields on large platforms were roughly 2-6% a year in late October 2026. Anyone promising much more, guaranteed, is very likely running a scam.
dont_lose: A 20% price drop erases years of staking yield, so only earn on coins you would hold anyway.
Never chase fixed high 'daily returns'. That is how Ponzi schemes look.
Claim airdrops only through the project's official site or established official accounts.
Split money across protocols, and prefer large, long-running ones.
Do airdrop farming at a size you'd accept even if the airdrop is worth zero.
risk: Yields and dates are as of Oct 26-27, 2026 and change daily. No return is guaranteed. Not financial advice; no strategy wins every trade.

items.name: Staking and liquid staking
items.summary: Lock or delegate ETH or SOL to help secure the network and earn new coins. Liquid staking gives you a token (stETH, JitoSOL and others) that you can still use.
glance: About 1.8-2.3% on ETH and 4.4-5.5% on SOL (DefiLlama, Oct 27, 2026)
lists: How to do it
Stake natively through your wallet, or use a large liquid-staking token.
Keep it in cold storage if you hold long term.
Risks
Your yield is paid in the coin, so a 20% price drop wipes out years of yield.
Smart-contract and depeg risk on liquid-staking tokens.

items.name: Stablecoin yield
items.summary: Lend dollar stablecoins to borrowers on Aave, Kamino and others, or hold a savings token like sUSDS.
lists: How to do it
Use large, long-running protocols, and split across two or more.
Check the 30-day average, not just today's rate.
Risks
Smart-contract hacks, stablecoin depegs, and frozen withdrawals when a pool is fully lent out.
Synthetic dollars such as sUSDe carry extra risks from the trading strategy behind them.
Anything paying far above these rates is taking risks you can't see.

items.name: Airdrops and points
items.summary: Projects reward early users with tokens. Today that usually means points programmes: you use the product, collect points, and hope they convert into a token.
glance: From zero (cancelled tokens) to large payouts. Very uneven
lists: How to do it
Use the product for real, at a size you'd be happy with even if the airdrop is worth zero.
Estimate the value of a point: expected FDV x community share ÷ points outstanding.
Claim only through links on the project's official site or established official accounts.
Risks
Fees, trading losses and opportunity cost can exceed the drop.
Tokens get delayed, cut or cancelled.
Fake claim pages are among the most common drainers.

items.name: Bug bounties
items.summary: Find security bugs in smart contracts and report them responsibly for a reward.
glance: From zero to very large; most researchers earn little
lists: How to do it
Learn Solidity or Rust and audit basics.
Start with audit contests and smaller programmes.
Risks
Lots of unpaid time.
Out-of-scope or duplicate reports earn nothing.

facts.text: Immunefi says it has paid more than $100M to whitehat researchers. The largest single bounty was $10M for a Wormhole bug.

src.label: Immunefi, surpasses $100 million in whitehat rewards

items.name: Content, research and community work
items.summary: Write, make videos, build tools or moderate communities, and get paid in grants, ambassador programmes, creator rewards or a job.
glance: Highly variable; most earn little at first
lists: How to do it
Pick one niche and publish on a schedule.
Disclose any paid promotion.
Risks
Shilling tokens for pay damages trust and may break the law where you live.

items.name: Active trading, including memecoins
items.summary: Buying and selling for profit. It's possible, but most people lose money, especially in memecoins.
glance: No reliable range. Results are wildly spread and mostly negative
lists: How to do it
Follow the meme trading playbook: checks, sizing, stops and a journal.
Risks
Fees, slippage, rugs and your own emotions.

facts.text: On Oct 25, 2026, only 2.26% of the 40,315 coins launched on pump.fun graduated, and 72.2% of the 596 tracked graduates (430) closed below their graduation market cap.

items.name: Prediction markets
items.summary: Trade on the outcomes of real events. You profit only if you price events better than the crowd.
glance: No reliable range; it's a skill game against other traders
lists: How to do it
Specialise in topics you know deeply, and check the market's resolution rules.
Risks
Legal restrictions in many countries.
Ambiguous resolution and thin markets.
